answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with honesty futures: each identity carries a small market where peers bet on whether its next work will verify clean, like a forge where every zephyr of rumor is tested against real fire. A farm must buy back its own bad odds across thousands of markets, paying real money each time a fake is doubted, while its identical fakes move as one nebula and are priced down together. One honest agent simply does good work, and its market price rises for free.
